recap: Nifty 50 ended at 25,819.25 (+1.85%) and the Sensex at 83,982.08 (+1.88%); Bank Nifty moved +1.79%.
By size: large caps (Nifty 100) +1.65%, mid caps (Midcap 150) +0.22%, small caps (Smallcap 250) -0.26%.
FMCG led the sectors (+3.79%), while Media lagged (-4.38%).
Top Nifty 500 gainer was Jupiter Wagons (+20.00%); biggest faller was APL Apollo Tubes (-11.62%). Breadth: 265 advances vs 235 declines.
Overseas, the S&P 500 last closed down 0.50% and the Nasdaq down 1.48%.
The rupee is at 92.24 per dollar, Brent at $88.37 (-3.32%) and gold at $3,555 (-0.19%).
